title: An OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint
summary:
OpenAI-compatible chat, DeepSeek and o3-mini joined a day of more deliberate image prompts and even a route in for Flash widgets.

Added POST /v1/chat/completions with streaming and non-streaming responses, giving existing OpenAI-style clients a familiar route into the text API.

DeepSeek joined text generation, while openai-reasoning switched from o1-mini to o3-mini. The reasoning model listing was also updated to mark vision support.

Short image prompts are no longer automatically enhanced. Image generation also gained an SDXL fallback for requests where Cloudflare Flux fails.

highlights.title: OpenAI-compatible chat
highlights.text: Send streaming or non-streaming chat requests to POST `/v1/chat/completions` using an OpenAI-compatible format. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: DeepSeek joins text generation
highlights.text: Generate text with the newly added DeepSeek integration. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Reasoning moves to o3-mini
highlights.text: `openai-reasoning` now routes to o3-mini instead of o1-mini; its model listing also marks vision support. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-reasoning).

highlights.title: Short prompts stay short
highlights.text: Short image prompts are no longer automatically enhanced, giving you more direct control over what you ask for. [Try image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Flash widgets can connect
highlights.text: Flash-based widgets, including those on older devices, can make cross-domain requests to the text and image services. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
